title: Carina: portrait round 6 (the liked tile, small changes to hair and expression)
question: Is any of these Carina, or which hair line and which expression line should I keep?

media.caption: The tile you liked ('The very last carina is most interesting') is first, then Mio and Kuro. Your words after round 5: "she only needed the original prompt and a bit of adjustment on hair and expression". So every tile here is that tile's exact prompt, negative, seed and settings with one or two phrases swapped in the hair line or the expression, no recolouring or editing of any kind. Hair 1: '(blonde hair with dark roots, honey blonde and golden lengths, obvious root regrowth:1.5)' replaces the dark-brown-crown-fading and 'ombre hair' phrase. Hair 2: '(blonde hair with dark roots and a few dark stripes, honey blonde and golden lengths:1.5)'. Hair 3: '(honey blonde hair, brown roots:1.5)'. Smile 1: '(soft smile:1.2)' and smile 2: '(relaxed expression, slightly amused:1.2)' replace '(confident slight smile:1.2)'. Tiles 1 to 10 are the original seed; the last three are a second seed of 3, 7 and 8. Not changed, as asked: the brows and lashes words are still the original's ('strong defined brows', 'long eyelashes'), so the brows and lashes are still fairly strong.
